scope: Original compiled selectors and static native DOM queries only; no style, layout, UI, JS, network, XML loading, website or Chrome performance.

Work budget overridden to usize::MAX to observe the reference quadratic cases; defaults otherwise unchanged. Benchmark sink black-boxes IDs, not a UI or full result vector.
